name: snow day
source:
Tyrone wants to see the snow.
Eva wants to confess her sins.
At near midnight, on this now-lonely street, only the two of us...

A short Wii sports fan visual novel about honesty and realizing that you're in love.

[From [url=https://mcq-heartmark.itch.io/snow-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
蒂龙想去看雪。
伊娃想要承认自己的罪行。
临近午夜，这条寂寥的街道上，只有我们两个人……

一部简短的Wii体育迷视觉小说，讲述诚实和意识到自己恋爱了。

[来自[url=https://mcq-heartmark.itch.io/snow-day]Itch.io[/url]]
